ITEM 1 | Fried rice-like mound of grains, light tan to golden brown with reddish-orange flecks, loose and slightly clumped, covering roughly 30% of the plate in the center-left area, about 10 cm across and 2 cm high, with some grains scattered at the edges | 150
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow-tan cubed or chunked pieces with browned edges, scattered among the rice on the left side, roughly 2 cm pieces, moist-looking surface, partly hidden under rice | 40
ITEM 3 | Small dark green leafy pieces, slightly wilted, interspersed among the rice near the lower left, about 1 cm each, glossy surface | 15
ITEM 4 | Shredded pale green and white cabbage with thin orange carrot matchsticks, lightly dressed-looking with a slight sheen, forming a loose mound about 9 cm by 6 cm and 3 cm high on the right side of the plate, covering roughly 20% of the plate | 90
ITEM 5 | Small pieces of bright orange carrot and a few green flecks mixed into the slaw, crisp-looking, scattered across the right mound | 15
ITEM 6 | Small red-orange pieces, possibly tomato-like chunks, soft and moist, mixed into the rice near the center, about 1 cm each | 10
